summary: Tested Expenses module additions (backend + frontend) end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering CRUD, void/unvoid, dashboard balance & by_expense_category (voided excluded), backup v2 with expenses[], restore merge, and seed. Frontend: verified Dashboard balance card & stat-expenses-card, 5-tab bottom nav, FAB → add-sheet with two choices, AddExpense form (description/amount/category chip/paid_by/mode/date/submit), Expenses list search + category filter + void/unvoid modal + edit prefill/persist, and dashboard balance decreased after adding an expense and restored after voiding. Chanda flow via FAB still works (regression spot-check passed).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/expenses/{id} update endpoint uses filtering `v is not None` which prevents setting paid_by/note back to null via PUT (same pattern as chanda update). Acceptable for current UX but worth noting.
Minor: server.py is ~482 lines — still fine, but as more modules are added it should be split into routers (chandas, collectors, expenses, dashboard/backup).
seed_data_creation: Backend /api/seed inserts 8 chandas + 4 collectors + 3 demo expenses (Tent, Prasad, Flowers). Test also created & voided a TEST_UI_Expense_Edited via UI; left in DB as voided (excluded from totals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_expenses.py covers full Expenses API + dashboard balance + backup v2 + restore. Mobile viewport 420x900 used for FAB. Header-add-btn only visible >=md/768px. Dashboard auto-calls /seed on load (idempotent). paidby-select is populated from /api/collectors.
